title: The ADHERENCE Index - the Indicator of Effective Coping With the Requirements of the Disease of Children and Adolescents With Type 1 Diabetes
brief_summary: The aim of the research is to develop a mathematical model called ADHERENCE index, and to evaluate its effectiveness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type 1 diabetes for min. 1 year
* CSII
* ability to come for one additional visit in outpatient diabetes clinic
* using glucometers

Exclusion Criteria:

* no possibility to download data from patient's glucometer and insulin pump
study_population: Participants will be recruited from the Outpatient Diabetes Clinic in the Institute of Mother and Child. Patient should be treated by intensive insulinotherapy using Continous Subcutaneus Infusion Set (CSII). Number of participants: 200.
